 Bournemouth & Brighton in the champions league next season.

 Sparta Prague 1-3 Bournemouth 
 Sparta have really fallen off in the second half and Sivert Mannsverk shoots wide from outside the box.

 FULL-TIME published at 19:38 GMT 19:38 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 1-1 Hoffenheim 
 No late winner for Palace as the corner comes to nothing.
 But we did get late fireworks as the hosts salvaged a point in added time.
 66 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:37 GMT 19:37 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 1-1 Hoffenheim 
 Just how important could that goal be for Pierre Sage's future at the club?
 Hang on a minute, Palace have a corner deep into added time. Surely not?
 80 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:36 GMT 19:36 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 1-1 Hoffenheim 
 There was a nervy VAR check after that but much to the relief of the Palace fans, the goal stands.
 120 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:36 GMT 19:36 GMT 
 FC Thun 3-1 Hearts 
 There's about 10 minutes to go in Hearts' game and the Scottish side have pulled a goal back through ex-Oxford defender Stuart Findlay.
 Follow Hearts' match right here. 
 13 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Rayan rocket' published at 19:36 GMT 19:36 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-3 Bournemouth 
 Joe Partington 
Former Bournemouth defender on BBC Radio Solent 
 Another unbelievable goal in Bournemouth fashion. They win the ball up high and Rayan has the opportunity to shoot. He rockets it into the corner.
 What an away day.
 136 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 INJURY TIME published at 19:36 GMT 19:36 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-3 Bournemouth 
 Five minutes added on as the Sparta fans start to head off into the night.
 49 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Sparta Prague 1-3 Bournemouth published at 19:34 GMT 19:34 GMT 
 Rayan (90 mins) 
 Game over.
 Bournemouth's third substitute on the scoresheet tonight. Rayan gets the ball 25 yards out after a one-two with Evanilson and drives the ball into the bottom corner with a lovely effort.
 459 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Crystal Palace 1-1 Hoffenheim published at 19:34 GMT 19:34 GMT 
 Daichi Kamada (90+1 mins) 
 In the nick of time!
 It's all a bit frantic in the penalty box but the ball comes in, it's headed back across the face of goal and Daichi Kamada pokes home.
 It's not a particularly powerful finish and it goes through goalkeeper Oliver Baumann's legs, he won't be happy with that.
 Palace have nicked a point right at the end.
 Image source, Reuters 
 591 50 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:33 GMT 19:33 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-2 Bournemouth 
 Good defending by Bournemouth's Bafode Diakite to stop Matyas Vojta getting a clear header on goal.
 78 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:33 GMT 19:33 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Palace with a real discipline problem.
 Nigel 
 62 63 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:33 GMT 19:33 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Hoffenheim are moments away from earning their first victory against an English side away from home in Europe.
 The referee heads over for a word wit Yeremy Pino after he fouls Koki Machida and there is concern for a minute that Palace could end up down to nine men but the referee just has a word with him.
 18 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Everything Rose touches turns to gold' published at 19:32 GMT 19:32 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-2 Bournemouth 
 Joe Partington 
Former Bournemouth defender on BBC Radio Solent 
 Bournemouth weren't great in the first half but they have something in them and they never say die. 
 Everything Marco Rose touches turns to gold and this second half has been brilliant.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 96 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing

 Paul

 Bournemouth are looking fairly comfortable now. Four minutes from a seventh consecutive win.

 Hoffenheim send Jykese Fields on for Wouter Burger as they try to see this one out.

 Sparta Prague 1-2 Bournemouth 
 Sparta's Matej Jurasek gets a merited yellow card for catching James Hill in the face with his arm. He was looking at the Bournemouth player before doing it.
